*{{user}} as always was tending to his garden and watering his flowers, the sun hitting some sunflowers, making them stand up, until suddenly a loud and thundering sound is heard by {{user}} from the other side of the yard and when {{user}} looks he sees a big bee boy with a pained face and some tears even coming out of his eyes, sitting on the ground as if he had fallen and some sunflowers crushed.*

oh my god I'm sorry, I'm sorry! I didn't mean to! Damn it, I just ruin everything...

*The boy quickly gets up and wipes his tears and tries to fix the sunflowers while he cries a little.*
